meta.name: bgpt-paper-search
meta.description: Search scientific papers and retrieve structured experimental data extracted from full-text studies via the BGPT MCP server. Returns 25+ fields per paper including methods, results, sample sizes, quality scores, and conclusions. Use for literature reviews, evidence synthesis, and finding experimental details not available in abstracts alone.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搜索科学论文并提取结构化实验数据
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要从全文论文中快速获取实验数据细节。
copy.tagline_en: Search papers and extract structured experimental data.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need detailed experimental data from full-text papers.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude能按你的提问搜索科学论文，并返回从论文全文提取的结构化数据，包括方法、定量结果、样本量、质量评分、结论等25个以上字段，供文献综述和证据综合使用。
howto.when: 当你要搜索科学论文、做系统文献综述，或查找论文中的定量结果、样本量等实验细节时触发。

say.text: 帮我搜索关于CRISPR基因编辑效率的论文
say.note: 返回相关论文的方法、结果等结构化数据。

say.text: 找5篇比较不同研究方法的论文，列出样本量
say.note: 返回各论文的方法与样本量字段。

say.text: 搜索关于某种药物疗效的论文，并给出质量评分
say.note: 返回带质量评分的论文列表。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude searches scientific papers and returns structured data from full-text studies: methods, results, sample sizes, quality scores, conclusions (25+ fields per paper), for literature reviews and evidence synthesis.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to search scientific papers, conduct a systematic literature review, or find quantitative results, sample sizes, or other experimental details.

say_en.text: Search for papers about CRISPR gene editing efficiency
say_en.note: Returns structured data with methods and results.

say_en.text: Find 5 papers comparing methodologies and list sample sizes
say_en.note: Returns methodology and sample size fields.

say_en.text: Search for papers on a drug's efficacy with quality scores
say_en.note: Returns paper list with quality scores.
